subject: Marine Works - Walkway Installation - Fraser River
text:
Marine Works - Walkway Installation - Fraser River
A walkway is to be installed across Canoe Passage at 49 04.818N 123 07.729W.
Hours of operation from 1330 to 0000 UTC daily from 28 Sept to 01 Dec.
A derrick barge will be on site monitoring VHF channel 18A. 
The barge will be anchored in the east navigational channel which will be closed for the duration of the project.
